Revenue / Acquisition economics

Fully loaded customer acquisition cost (CAC)

The total acquisition-related sales and marketing cost per new paying customer. Include allocated payroll, agencies, creative, media, software, commissions, and agreed overhead without double counting. The exact allocation policy should be documented.

Explore in the metric hierarchy ↗Open calculators →
Level 4Inspect the detail

The total acquisition-related sales and marketing cost per new paying customer. Include allocated payroll, agencies, creative, media, software, commissions, and agreed overhead without double counting. The exact allocation policy should be documented.

currency / new customer

How we use it

Compare this with cohort gross-profit value and payback. We can build a cost ledger joined to CRM customer records so budget decisions reflect the wider acquisition investment.

Transparent calculationTotal allocated acquisition sales and marketing costs ÷ new paying customers acquired by that cost scope
media cost6,000
payroll and other acquisition costs9,000
new paying customers12

(6,000 + 9,000) ÷ 12 = 1,250 currency units of fully loaded acquisition cost per new customer.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Acquisition cohort and segment
  • Channel and sales motion
  • Allocated cost category

Questions we investigate

  • Are payroll and tools included in the cost scope?
  • Does the customer cohort match acquisition spend?
  • Are allocation or timing changes distorting comparison?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Reconcile fully loaded acquisition costs.
  • Document shared-cost allocation and cohort maturity.
  • Review CAC with margin, retention, and payback.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Finance and revenue operations leads
Monthly after acquisition costs and customers close.

Required data

  • Allocated sales and marketing cost ledger
  • New paying customer cohort and first payments
  • Cost scope, currency, and allocation policy

Read the measure with context

Zero new customers makes CAC undefined. Align spend and conversion timing when sales cycles are long. Acquisition and retention expenses need consistent allocation. Media-only CAC is a narrower metric and should carry a separate label.
